detail: Minimum 75% mandatory attendance in previous academic terms.
No backlogs, compartments or failed subjects; must be a regular student without academic disciplinary actions.
A candidate can contest only once for a central office bearer post.
Maximum campaign expenditure capped at ₹5,000 per candidate. Audited accounts must be submitted post-election.
Complete ban on printed posters, spray painting, wall pasting and pamphlets on campus or metro property.
Campaign material restricted strictly to handmade posters displayed on designated university boards.
Prohibition of heavy vehicles, open jeeps, tractors and convoy parades on campus roads.
